name: Hay Day farm

provenance.source: Hay Day Wiki expansion pages and map image (plot costs, numbering, shapes reconstructed); v1 public map shifted into the game frame

license: Plot cost tables, plot numbering and release dates are adapted from the Hay Day Wiki (Fandom) page 'Expansion/Farm' and related pages (contributors: see each page history), licensed CC BY-SA (https://www.fandom.com/licensing). This file is therefore shared under CC BY-SA 3.0. Tile geometry was derived by us from the wiki map images (images not redistributed).
origin_note: Game tile frame: X runs along the road (screen down-right), Y from the cliff/forest to the road (screen down-left). Starting land X 0..31, Y 0..31; main road Y 32..36. Negative tiles (river, forest) are scenery, never buildable.

notes: Starting land is 32x32 (verified in client data); the 48x32 alternative map was retired and its layouts migrate to this map.
Main road: a strip directly south of the starting land, 5 tiles deep (conclusion from client data research); nothing can be built on it.
Main-section plot shapes are reconstructed from the Hay Day Wiki map image (approximation; subsection widths 16/8/15/14 measured vs 17/8/15/13 in wiki text).
Upper plots and all across-the-road sections exist in the game but their public tile geometry is unknown; they are listed, not drawn.
Landmark positions (farmhouse, truck, order board, roadside shop, mailbox) are approximate; install the private world data from your own game files for the real positions and every other landmark.
River and forest edge are schematic placeholders outside the placement grid.
